title: Geo-VLA: Geometry-Aware Vision-Language-Action Planning via Internalization of Map Semantics
abstract: arXiv:2608.21440v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have advanced end-to-end autonomous driving by leveraging foundation models for semantic reasoning and long-tail generalization. However, their planning performance remains limited in complex driving environments because image-only representations inadequately capture planning-relevant road geometry and topology. In this paper, we propose Geo-VLA, a plug-and-play framework that enhances VLA models by learning geometry-aware visual representations. During training, Geo-VLA internalizes geometric map semantics to strengthen road-structure representations, while requiring no HD maps or additional lane information during inference. To support this approach, we introduce Geo-QA, a geometry-focused question-answering dataset that injects road geometry into vision-language representations through contrastive learning and instruction tuning. translated_title: Geo-VLA：通过地图语义内化实现几何感知的视觉-语言-动作规划
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型通过利用基础模型进行语义推理和长尾泛化，推动了端到端自动驾驶的发展。然而，在复杂驾驶环境中，其规划性能仍然有限，因为仅基于图像的表示不足以捕捉与规划相关的道路几何和拓扑信息。在本文中，我们提出Geo-VLA，一个即插即用的框架，通过学习几何感知的视觉表示来增强VLA模型。在训练过程中，Geo-VLA内化几何地图语义以强化道路结构表示，而在推理时无需高清地图或额外车道信息。为支持该方法，我们引入Geo-QA，一个面向几何的问答数据集，通过对比学习和指令微调将道路几何注入视觉-语言表示中。在NAVSIM v1上的实验表明，Geo-VLA持续提升了规划性能。
tldr: Geo-VLA通过内化地图语义来增强VLA模型，无需推理时的高清地图，从而提升复杂驾驶环境中的几何感知规划能力。
en_tdlr: Geo-VLA enhances VLA models by internalizing map semantics without requiring HD maps at inference, improving geometry-aware planning in complex driving environments.
